scripts.clear:all: npx rimraf target allure-results allure-report allure-history screenshots videos build
scripts.clear:results: npx rimraf target/allure-results target/allure-results-chrome target/allure-results-firefox target/allure-results-edge target/allure-results-safari allure-report
scripts.report:generate: node calculate-quality-gate.js && npx allure generate target/allure-results --config allurerc.js --output allure-report && node post-generate.js
scripts.report:generate:cross: node calculate-quality-gate.js && npx allure generate target/allure-results-chrome target/allure-results-firefox target/allure-results-safari --config allurerc.js --output allure-report && node post-generate.js
scripts.merge:results: mkdir -p target/allure-results && b_list=""; for b in chrome firefox edge safari; do dir="target/allure-results-$b"; if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ "$(ls -A $dir 2>/dev/null)" ]; then cp "$dir"/* target/allure-results/ 2>/dev/null || true; b_list="$b_list $(echo $b | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"; fi; done; b_clean=$(echo $b_list | xargs | tr ' ' ','); if [ -n "$b_clean" ]; then echo "Browsers.Used=$b_clean" >> target/allure-results/environment.properties; fi
scripts.test: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test -Dcucumber.filter.tags='@smoke' ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:regression: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test -Dcucumber.filter.tags='@regression' ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:video: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test -Drecord.video=true ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:headless: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test -Dheadless=true ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:browser: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test -Dbrowser=${BROWSER:-chrome} -Dheadless=${HEADLESS:-false} ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:browser:headless: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test -Dbrowser=${BROWSER:-chrome} -Dheadless=true ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:tag: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "mvn test -Dcucumber.filter.tags=${TAG} ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:cross-browser: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "bash run-cross-browser.sh ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
scripts.test:cross-browser:headless: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.js -- sh -c "bash run-cross-browser-headless.sh ; node calculate-quality-gate.js" && npm run report:open
